artifacts.summary: Both plan phases completed: orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh now unconditionally emits a Wait Discipline pointer section, and a new Group 14 test asserts presence/uniqueness/ordering across base and hard mode for all three phases.

completion_data.completion_summary: Added an unconditional '## Wait Discipline' pointer section (to context/patterns/external-process-wait.md) to every dispatch file orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh writes, across base/--hard mode and research/plan/implement phases, plus a header comment documenting it as a deliberate exception; added Group 14 test coverage (presence, single-occurrence guard, ordering) that passes 106/0 including all pre-existing exact-diff groups.

memory_candidates.content: When a script writes a single { ... } > "$file" block with several conditionally-gated sections, an UNCONDITIONAL addition (one that must appear regardless of any flag) should be placed as a plain echo sequence immediately adjacent to an existing unconditional section (not inside any if), with a header-comment note naming both blocks as deliberate, permanent exceptions to the file's own byte-identical-when-inactive invariant. This keeps future contributors from 'fixing' the block into a gated one. Verify with a negative control: temporarily remove the new echo lines, confirm the new test fails, then restore.
